messages:
Clara J.: quick one — my calendar shows orientation at 8:00 but there is no join link on the tile. anyone else? :raised_hand:
Onboarding Bot: Official join: https://zoom.us/j/890123456 (passcode: `redwood-join`). If your event has no link, accept the invite from 'People Ops / Onboarding' and decline duplicates. ICS: https://redwood.app/ical/onboard_main.ics :calendar:
Min K.: FYI two invites were sent; accepted People Ops and removed the other. Also check your calendar app timezone settings — sometimes mobile shows local DST wrong.
Clara J.: thanks — timezone check? i'm in KST (UTC+9).
Omar L.: 8:00 PT = 11:00 ET = 16:00 UTC = 01:00 KST (next day). I'll paste a short table in the event notes for APAC folks.
People Ops: We'll record the session. Recording + transcript will be uploaded to Drive (New Hires > Sessions) and linked here in #new-hires once ready (~30-90 mins). Breakout rooms are not included in main transcript. If you need captions in a breakout, DM us and we'll arrange a notetaker or alternate capture.
Clara J.: perfect. last thing — the event tile shows 'Guests can't join' even though i'm internal. should I be worried?
People Ops: That's just a privacy label; the Zoom URL works regardless. If clicking the link actually blocks you, ping us immediately and we'll escalate with IT.
Min K.: accepted the correct invite and saved the Zoom link. thanks all! :wave:
